# StPageFlip

Self-hosted page-flip 2.0.7 ES module, distributed under the included MIT license.
Source: https://github.com/Nodlik/StPageFlip
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/page-flip

Provides soft page folds, animated shadows, and pointer-driven page turning. PDF pages are rasterized on demand and passed as images because the library clones page elements during folds.
